title: A kb/_self heading rename does not select the test of the skills' section commands
goal: testmap.py selects _tools/test_selfdoc.py (at least its skill_section_headings tests) for a change to a kb/_self/*.md doc, so renaming a heading a skill reads with selfdoc.py section fails the gate of the change that renames it

run: import subprocess, sys; out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/testmap.py', 'select', '--paths', 'kb/_self/backlog.md'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split(); print(out); sys.exit(0 if 'all' in out or any(s.startswith('_tools/test_selfdoc.py') for s in out) else 1)
